'what_changed' is the one column no tool can derive (a schedule change, a certificate change, a different obstacle); 'stage_bytes_vs_previous' is the measured verdict against the previous version where it was taken. Deletion test: without this file nobody can tell a schedule change from an obstacle change. Versions are labels over hashes; the evidence binds hashes. 'label' (optional) is the short tag printed beside the version number where the number alone does not say what changed (the composed stacks: pallets, pallets, cartons); a schedule-only change needs none.
